name: Radio
description: Adds a Radio channel with Dutch radio stations (NPO, Qmusic, 538, Sky Radio, regional broadcasters and more). Each station is a live audio item, so it plays in Jellyfin's music player on the web, the desktop app and the Android and iOS apps, and can be cast. Administrators choose the stations, their names and logos on the plugin page; a built-in list of tested Dutch stations is included.
overview: Listen to Dutch radio stations in every Jellyfin app.

versions.changelog: Test build, published as a GitHub pre-release and installable from this repository's manifest, to run the checks in docs/SPIKES.md before v0.1.0. A **Radio** channel (Home, My Media) in which every station is a live audio item. It plays in Jellyfin's music player on the   web; Jellyfin Desktop and the Android and iOS apps are being verified. 44 Dutch stations built in, 33 of them switched on:   - NPO, the national commercial stations and 12 regional public broadcasters.   - Every stream was checked on 2026-10-13 and its format read from the stream itself.   - Only MP3 streams: Jellyfin cannot convert live AAC. A plugin page to manage the stations:   - Switch stations on and off, rename them, change logos and add your own.   - Reorder them; the apps follow the page's order.   - **Test** checks a stream URL and measures its format.   - A StreamTheWorld node URL is replaced by the stable redirect URL.   - Playlists (.m3u, .pls) and AAC streams are refused with an explanation.   - A changed stream URL must be tested again before it can be saved. Renamed stations and new logos reach the existing items, so favourites keep working. Diagnostics on the plugin page:   - Which stations Jellyfin would serve, and as what.   - Users who cannot see the channel: no channel access, forced transcoding of remote sources, or unrated channel content blocked. Options:   - Don't redirect apps (Android Auto) to the station; the server streams it instead.   - Hide the channel from chosen users, such as a living-room Android TV account. The Radio channel refuses requests for folders inside it (it has none).
